quote: A US$54.1 million contract has been awarded for the construction of a new, state-of-the-art West Demerara Regional Hospital, the National Procurement and Tender Administration Board (NPTAB) has announced. The contract was awarded on December 31, 2024 to CAMCE and Sinopharm Int’l (China CAMC Engineering CO. Limited and China Sinopharm International Corporation), a consortium for US$54,169,883.76.
note: UNVERIFIED proxy: Kaieteur News 15 Jan 2025 citing NPTAB award details; NPTAB portal PDF not opened this cycle.
